title_zh: 中国共产党安徽省第十二届纪律检查委员会委员名单
title_en: List of Members of the 12th Anhui Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China
summary_zh: 2026年10月，中共安徽省第十二次代表大会产生第十二届纪律检查委员会，65名委员名单按姓氏笔画排序公布。
summary_en: In October 2026, the Communist Party of China's Anhui Provincial Congress released the list of 65 members of the 12th Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, arranged by surname stroke order.
body_zh:
